description: Meta ops Forge uses (or will use). Phase A = serial single-op. Open modes are distinct ops.

ops.label: Cold/fresh open (close prior owned window, spawn new)
ops.notes: Each sample: ensure no owned window, spawn, map→settle

ops.label: Warm open (process already running; launch again)
ops.notes: After a living window exists: launch again without killing first. Multi-instance → second map; single-instance → focus/reuse path

ops.label: change_workspace to spare then back intent
ops.notes: Move window to workspace index+1 (mod n); measures workspace Meta churn

ops.label: Focus other workspace then back (window stays)
ops.notes: Visibility/restack: switch active WS away and back without moving window

ops.label: minimize then unminimize
ops.notes: Compound but atomic product path; settle after unminimize
